ticket.title: Level 4 (Twin Bridges): player falls through the stone ledge/floor after the second bridge and falls endlessly
ticket.summary: After patch 1.4, players fall through the floor or stone platform right after the second bridge on Twin Bridges and keep falling without dying, so they must restart or quit (A045, A072, A109, A116). Level 4 completion dropped from 80% to 43% and restarts rose from 1.2 to 2.6, while deaths/player stayed flat (2.1 to 2.2). 30 distinct players reported it, with an estimated 2946 players lost.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Physics and collision optimisation" - the reports start after the 1.4 update (A060, A123, A164) and describe the character passing through ground collision on the stone ledge after the second bridge. A005 and A158 say it sometimes does not happen when moving slowly, which suggests a collision check that fails at higher speed or on landing.
repro_steps: Start Ember Trail on patch 1.4 and load level 4 (Twin Bridges).
Cross the first bridge and then the second bridge.
Jump off the second bridge and land on the stone ledge/platform after it (A005, A132, A143).
Observe the character pass through the ground and fall endlessly without dying (A045, A116).
Optionally repeat while walking slowly onto the ledge; per A005 and A158 this sometimes avoids the fall.
Restart the game or quit, as the fall never ends (A072, A109).

issues.title: Level 6 Magma Warden boss: health appears roughly doubled after 1.4, causing a drop in completion and doubled deaths

ticket.title: Level 6 Magma Warden boss: health appears roughly doubled after 1.4, causing a drop in completion and doubled deaths
ticket.summary: After patch 1.4, level 6 completion fell from 70% to 51% and deaths/player rose from 4.1 to 8.3, with restarts up from 1.8 to 2.9 (an estimated 462 players lost). 20 distinct players report that the Magma Warden has much more HP, and several say it is about double (A066, A087, A157). Players also describe longer fights and more attempts: phase 2 now survives 3 full combos instead of 1 (A167), and one player needed 20+ tries versus 3 before (A162).
ticket.suspected_cause: "Boss tuning pass" in the 1.4 patch notes likely raised Magma Warden's health. Players report the change started with 1.4 and describe about double HP (A066, A087, A157) and phase 2 surviving 3 combos instead of 1 (A167). A037 also says the level 6 boss rebalance "went way too far".
repro_steps: Install patch 1.4 and load a save that has reached level 6.
Start the Magma Warden boss fight.
In phase 2, land full combos and count how many the boss survives (A167 reports 3, versus 1 before the patch).
Time the full fight and count attempts to win (A105 reports phase 2 alone lasts 4 minutes, A173 reports 5 minutes for the fight, and A087 reports 30 tries).
Compare the boss's effective HP, fight duration and attempt count with the pre-1.4 build (A147 reports passing in 2-3 tries before; A162 reports 3 tries before).

ticket.title: Old Mill (Level 2): checkpoint shows 'saved' icon but loading returns player to start of level
ticket.summary: 12 distinct players report that the Old Mill checkpoint displays the save icon, but loading or relaunching the game puts them at the beginning of level 2 (A014, A024, A041, A155). Telemetry shows restarts rising from 1.1 to 1.8, completion dipping from 92% to 90% and error reports from 1 to 2, while deaths/player stays flat at 1, so this is progress loss rather than a difficulty spike. The estimated players lost is 229.
ticket.suspected_cause: "Save system refactor" - the reports begin after the patch (A027: 'since the patch') and describe the save icon appearing while the data is not restored on load. A163 suggests the write may not finish if the player quits within a few seconds of the icon, which points to an incomplete or delayed save write, though this is not confirmed.
repro_steps: Start or continue a game and play through to the Old Mill checkpoint in level 2.
Trigger the checkpoint and confirm the 'saved' icon appears (A041, A155).
Quit the game immediately after the icon (A163, A083), and separately try waiting a few seconds before quitting to compare.
Relaunch the game and load the save (A051, A133).
Observe whether the player starts at the beginning of level 2 instead of the Old Mill checkpoint (A014, A024).
